title: Crowded lobby entity stress

readiness.description: The lobby and entity population are loaded before warmup.

readiness.description: Entity, UI, frame and upload telemetry is available.

warmup.semantics: Discard the declared warmup frame range before entity measurement.
warmup.missing_reason: Warmup frame count has not been selected.

measurement.semantics: Include exactly the declared contiguous lobby measurement frames.
measurement.missing_reason: Measurement frame count has not been selected.

image.missing_reason: A clean light-v2 diagnostic image is archived, but no pinned parity reference or visibility qualification is defined.

visibility.description: Visible entity identities and UI state at the lobby checkpoint.
visibility.missing_reason: A diagnostic image is archived, but visible entity identity and UI state have not been independently checked.

known_limitations: Draft only; no entity population or stress result is asserted.
A terrain capture must not be relabeled as a lobby fixture.
The light-v2 diagnostic image is not a pinned parity reference and visibility qualification remains open.
Replay uses ordinary wall-clock timing, so nondeterminism remains and scoring is not eligible.
